EVENT_ROW_REFLOW_WIDTH.rule: rowWidth < EVENT_ROW_REFLOW_WIDTH => 2-line deterministic grouping; else 1 line (today)

NOT FlowRow (PO: deterministic layout for structured data rows; card-list declined for the 1-D log, see spec 2.2.1).
